en.headline: Police arrest 29-year-old man for slapping Tsim Sha Tsui taxi driver
en.dek: Officers detained the suspect in Wong Tai Sin on Wednesday afternoon on suspicion of common assault after a dispute over an automatic door early Tuesday.
body: Police arrested a 29-year-old man surnamed Leung in Wong Tai Sin on Wednesday afternoon on suspicion of common assault, after he allegedly slapped a taxi driver in Tsim Sha Tsui.

The 32-year-old driver reported the incident at about 3am on Tuesday, saying he had picked up a male passenger near Nathan Road and got into an argument after telling the man not to force open the automatic door. The driver was not seriously injured and later sought treatment at hospital.
Dashcam footage circulated online showed the confrontation on Hillwood Road. Police said the case was being handled by the Yau Tsim anti-triad unit and the man was detained for investigation.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕29歲男子 涉掌摑尖沙咀的士司機
zh.dek: 警方周三下午在黃大仙區以涉嫌普通襲擊拘捕姓梁男子，案件源於周二凌晨因自動車門爭執。
body: 警方周三下午在黃大仙區拘捕一名29歲姓梁男子，涉嫌普通襲擊。他被指周二凌晨在尖沙咀掌摑一名的士司機。
32歲司機約凌晨3時報案，指在彌敦道附近接載男乘客後，因勸阻對方強行拉開自動車門而發生爭執。司機沒有嚴重受傷，其後自行前往醫院接受治療。
網上有行車紀錄儀片段顯示山林道的對峙情況。警方表示案件由油尖反黑組跟進，男子正被扣留調查。
